# cli.validate_lon_lat_columns { #healpyxel.cli.validate_lon_lat_columns }

```python
cli.validate_lon_lat_columns(df, lon_col, lat_col, mode, input_file)
```

Validate or auto-detect longitude/latitude columns.

Used by the sidecar and aggregate pipelines to resolve which
DataFrame columns contain the geographic coordinates required for
the HEALPix spatial join.  Supports explicit user-provided names or
auto-detection from a common-name list.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type         | Description                                                                         | Default    |
|------------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| df         | pd.DataFrame | Input parquet content loaded into a DataFrame.                                      | _required_ |
| lon_col    | str or None  | User-provided longitude column name (``None`` triggers auto-detect).                | _required_ |
| lat_col    | str or None  | User-provided latitude column name (``None`` triggers auto-detect).                 | _required_ |
| mode       | str          | Processing mode string (``'strict'`` or ``'fuzzy'``).  Used in error messages only. | _required_ |
| input_file | str or Path  | Source file path for error-reporting context.                                       | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type              | Description                                           |
|--------|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | tuple\[str, str\] | ``(lon_col, lat_col)`` for the resolved column names. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                                                  |
|--------|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | * If the user-provided columns are not in ``df.columns``. * If auto-detection fails (no common names found). |
